_comment: Config for sync-distros.ps1. WATCHED paths are walked under .minecraft/ and compared across server_distribution/ and distribution/client/. EXCLUDE_PATTERNS are wildcard patterns (PowerShell -like syntax) applied to the forward-slash relative path. Tune these as the project evolves; the pre-push hook reads this file at run time.

_architecture_notes.the_rule: Per CLAUDE.md 'Distribution Sync': all changes to kubejs, configs, datapacks, or lang files must be mirrored to all three distros (main, server_distribution, distribution/client). In practice this script enforces a conservative subset (server_scripts + startup_scripts) where divergence is almost always a real bug; the rest is left to manual discipline or other tools.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/server_scripts: WATCHED. Authoritative source is main; distros mirror. As of the post-cutover audit, server_distribution had 140 files vs main's 139 (one orphan) -- ground-truth which to keep before installing the hook.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/startup_scripts: WATCHED. Authoritative source is main; distros mirror.
_architecture_notes.cleanup_stale_jars.ps1: WATCHED (single file). The shared mod-hygiene script MUST be byte-identical across main + the two distros; it had silently diverged (server copy missing iridescent_relics in its allowlist) -> #70. Authoritative source is the main copy; distros mirror. NOTE: the server-runtime SEED copy at server_distribution/'IridescentCraft Dedicated Server'/ is outside this distro-root model -> now auto-mirrored via EXTRA_MIRRORS (2026-06-07); Layer 2.5 manifest-keep remains the non-fatal backstop.
_architecture_notes.custom_jars_manifest.json: WATCHED (single file). The SHA-256 manifest is the single source of truth for custom-jar identity AND (as of #70) the cleanup keep-decision. regen_custom_jars_manifest.ps1 writes all three identically; this gate verifies they stayed identical so a half-applied regen can't ship.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/client_scripts: NOT WATCHED. server_distribution strips client_scripts that touch client-only classes (per CLAUDE.md Server Mod Compatibility Audit). distribution/client should mirror main but a single-direction-mirror check would need a per-distro WATCHED system this script doesn't yet support.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/libraries: EXCLUDED. KubeJS-generated IDE autocomplete stubs; never present in distros.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/assets: WATCHED (since 2026-06-07). The old 'varies legitimately' note was documenting DRIFT as design: audit found stale tetra lang (June 1 vs June 3) + a theabyss lang dir that never left main -> raw workbench IDs on tester screens. Client renders from ITS kubejs/assets, so distribution/client staleness is player-visible. Authoritative source is main; distros mirror.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/config: NOT WATCHED. KubeJS-internal config files (probe-settings.json, etc) vary per environment.
_architecture_notes.datapack_sources: NOT WATCHED. Build SOURCES for custom datapack jars (iridescent_codex_data.jar etc). Distros ship the BUILT jar in mods/, not the source tree. Only present in main.
_architecture_notes.config: NOT WATCHED (whole tree). Mod configs legitimately differ server vs client. The paxi/datapacks subtree is watched separately (see its note).
_architecture_notes.mods: NOT WATCHED. packwiz manages these; custom jars need the verify_distros.sh|.bat|.ps1 helper per deployment-and-utility-guide.md, not this script.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/server_scripts/validate_recipe_re: EXCLUDED. Dev-only validator (master-appendix.md §126: 'run at server start as a sanity check for stale IDs'); intentionally not deployed to the distributions.
_architecture_notes.kubejs/data: WATCHED (since 2026-06-07). Verified byte-identical x3 at adoption; datapack-style server data must not drift.
_architecture_notes.config/paxi/datapacks: WATCHED (since 2026-06-07). Paxi zips were always supposed to be identical x3 (manual-copy rule); verified identical at adoption. Rebuild zips into main, run -Fix to propagate.

EXTRA_MIRRORS._why: #74a: the server-runtime SEED copy sits outside the distro-root model; this pair-mirror closes the last by-hand parity loop
